These form a Boolean vector (L, R, F) ∈ {0,1}³. The system adopts only when all criteria are satisfied. This structure mirrors a Bayesian decision boundary in a discrete hypothesis space. Dualities emerge in that any single violation leads to rejection, while full alignment enables adoption. Failure modes include false positives from ambiguous license metadata or incorrect runtime detection. The system assumes deterministic evaluation of each feature, but real-world ambiguity may require probabilistic refinement.
